teach_en: Everyday Lao often leaves out 'I', 'you' or 'he/she' when it is clear who is meant. Asked ເຈົ້າຫິວນ້ຳບໍ່? ('Are you thirsty?'), you can answer ຫິວນ້ຳ ('I'm thirsty') with no 'I'. This is normal everyday Lao.
notes: PLAN L1d (b), owner play-test 2026-11-13. Placed after S000002889 ຫິວນ້ຳ (reply to S000001170 ເຈົ້າຫິວນ້ຳບໍ່?) rather than at ບໍ່ຫິວ: the native speaker endorsed ຫິວເຂົ້າ / ຫິວນ້ຳ, while bare ບໍ່ຫິວ as a reply is still asked in QUESTIONS (curriculum review). ຂ້ອຍ is taught only in L0010, so pronouns are named in English. No respellings in the text (LESSON_RULES 13). Wording by agent.
